item.title: Springfield Rep. Jeremy Dean sanctioned by Missouri House over lewd text message
item.description: The Missouri House of Representatives voted 138-10 to sanction Rep. Jeremy Dean for sending an obscene text message to Rep. Cecile Williams during a hearing, resulting in his removal from committee assignments and additional sexual harassment training.

item.title: Winter Storm Timeline: When Heavy Snow and Extreme Cold Hit the Ozarks
